function.arguments: {"reason": "The initial analysis incorrectly excluded rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 before deduplication, which altered the population by removing some patients who were otherwise in the treatment arm. This violated the contract, which defines the population as all treatment-arm patients after deduplication, regardless of biomarker values. The correction was to deduplicate first (preserving all patients), then filter to the treatment arm. The biomarker_baseline == -999 rows are now included in the treatment arm if they are the highest-sample_seq row for their patient. This ensures the population matches the contract. The exclusion of -999 values was not justified for this estimand because biomarker_baseline is not part of the response fraction calculation. The new analysis respects the population definition."}
function.name: resolve_finding
